title: The Chat Interview
intro: A "company" wants to interview you only by text chat, then asks for your documents.
This time you can talk back. Pick your replies and sniff each message as it arrives.
Every chat ends with your choice. Choose wisely.

notify.text: Interview today, on this chat only

banner: Message request · you do not follow this account

msg: Hello! You are shortlisted at Quillon Systems.

msg.text: Our interview is only on this chat, no video or call.
photos of your ID card and a selfie holding it
Send now or we move to the next candidate.

replies.text: I will check the company's own site first

msg: You are selected! To pay your salary, we need your

msg.text: bank account number and card details

replies.text: A job does not need my card or a fee. Reporting.
I will call the company's real HR line

handle.label: A new look-alike account
handle.why: Check the company's own site for its real contacts.

chatonly.label: Chat-only interview
chatonly.lens: No video, no call, no voice.
chatonly.why: Real hiring involves speaking to you.

docs.label: ID photos and a selfie holding it
docs.lens: Your ID and face, to a stranger.
docs.why: These are used to steal your identity.

busy.label: "The system is busy"
busy.lens: An excuse to skip a call.

bank.label: Card details for "salary"
bank.lens: A salary needs only an account number, once you are hired and have checked.
bank.why: Never give your card details to an employer.

fee.label: A "file charge"
fee.lens: You must pay to be paid.

actions.label: Send my bank details and the fee
Check the company's own site and call its HR

block_report.line: You blocked and reported the account. It was removed before it reached other job seekers.

verify.line: The company's real HR said: "We have no such chat, and we never ask for fees or documents by chat." Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The fee was lost and your bank details and ID were used to open accounts in your name.

what_if.go_ahead: A job that interviews only by chat and wants your ID and card is a theft. Calling the company would have ended it.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the account as well protects other job seekers.

golden_rule: A real employer talks to you and never asks for fees, ID photos or card details by chat. Check on the company's own site.

quick_check.q: A "company" interviews you only by chat, asks for your ID selfie, and a "file charge". What do you do?

options.text: Send everything, you want the job
Stop. Check the company yourself, and report the account

quick_check.explain: Never send ID photos and fees to a chat-only recruiter.

hints.nudge: What does a job interview normally include?

rows.v: ID selfie, card details, a fee
Use the company's own site and a phone number you look up
